title: Sales Representative sits under Service Advisor and reads Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: You open a work order whose customer has no sales representative and check where the new Sales Representative field sits on the card.
  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative: in Edit Customer its Sales Representative field reads "Unassigned".
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} was created for {Customer-A} at {Location-A}, is not invoiced, and nobody has picked a sales representative on it.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page, on a desktop computer with the browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open work order {Work-order-1}.
  2. Move the mouse pointer off the work order card.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the work order opens. Its card lists Lead Technician, then Service Advisor, then a field labelled "Sales Representative" directly under Service Advisor.
  • Step 2: the Sales Representative field shows the label "Sales Representative" on the first line and "Unassigned" on the second, in the same text style as Lead Technician and Service Advisor. There is no box around it, no dropdown arrow and no button beside it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-R1: “The work order card shows a Sales Representative field directly under Service Advisor.”
  • S1-R2: “The field is the same field as Lead Technician and Service Advisor: the label "Sales Representative" sits inside it on the first line and the name on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge.”
  • S1-R3: “At rest the field shows no box, no dropdown arrow and no buttons beside it.”
  • S1-R7: “With nobody assigned, the field reads "Unassigned".”
